broader_coverage.reasoning: Bennett--Nichols Theorem 14 gives an exact fixed-graph large-t formula. For the 2n-vertex diameter-2 graph K_2 square K_n it yields n(2t-n+1) only under its stated threshold t >= 2n-1, so it does not cover n <= t <= 2n-2 or the low-tone branch. Their Theorem 13 concerns symmetric K_n^2 and requires MOLS.

originality.rationale: No inspected source implies the exact all-tone formula. Known results cover t=2, selected symmetric clique products, or only a sufficiently-large-t tail; the present proof determines the entire two-parameter spectrum and moves the high-tone exact threshold to t=n. The unavailable full text of the 2017 Cartesian-product article is retained as a residual risk.
residual_risks: The full text of Cooper--Wash (2017) was not retrieved, so an unindexed equivalent statement there cannot be excluded absolutely.
Terminology variants outside the searched line-graph, Cartesian-product, clique-prism, and complete-bipartite formulations may exist.
